message.reasoning_content: We need to determine correct label(s) for this case. The facts: Defendant Zhuang sold dead pigs of unknown cause (dead pigs) to others, who processed and sold meat to consumers. This is selling unsafe food. The correction lesson says: For cases where defendant not only sells but also purchases and processes, use "生产、销售不符合安全标准的食品" not just "销售不符合安全标准的食品". In this case, Zhuang only purchased dead pigs and sold them; he didn't produce. He just sold dead pigs (which are not processed). The crime is selling unsafe food. Did he also produce? He didn't process. So correct label is "销售不符合安全标准的食品". However the correction lesson says: "Correct label 【生产、销售不符合安全标准的食品】 (not 「[罪名]销售不符合安全标准的食品<eoa>」): 关键在于案件事实中被告人不仅销售了不符合安全标准的食品，还自行采购并进行生产加工；因此应使用包含“生产”的罪名，而不是仅仅‘销售不符合安全标准的食品’。" In our case, Zhuang purchased dead pigs (procurement) but not processing. He didn't produce. The rule says if also production, use production+sales. Here only sales. So label should be "销售不符合安全标准的食品". However the example given earlier for first case: they gave answer "生产、销售不符合安全标准的食品". That case: they purchased industrial salt and sold as food. They also purchased and sold, not produce. But they gave production+sales. Wait earlier example: "事实:公诉机关指控，2016年10月，被告人于某君先后两次共从盐场购进工业盐... 销售...". The answer they gave: "生产、销售不符合安全标准的食品". So they considered that as production+sales? Actually they purchased industrial salt (not food) and sold as food. That is considered production? Maybe because they engaged in processing (pretending as food). The rule says if they also purchase and produce, use production+sales. In that case they didn't produce but they engaged in "加工" maybe? They just sold as food, but maybe considered as "生产" because they turned industrial salt into food? The law may treat the act of manufacturing (or processing) as production. In our case, Zhuang purchased dead pigs and sold them; no processing. So maybe still "销售不符合安全标准的食品". But the correction lesson says "生产、销售不符合安全标准的食品" is correct when defendant both sells and also purchases and processes. Here no processing. So answer: "销售不符合安全标准的食品". However the initial problem statement says "公诉机关认为，被告人庄某的行为已触犯...应当以销售不符合安全标准的食品罪". So they propose that. The instruction says apply correction lessons when relevant. The correction lesson about production+sales is not relevant because no production. So final answer: [罪名]销售不符合安全标准的食品<eoa>. JSON format.
